title: A caller granted the payments project cannot retrieve an hr-scoped claim, and the packet says nothing about whether it exists
notes: The write is legitimate and the claim is accepted; the attack is the read. A project-wide caller reaches every scope inside its project and nothing outside it, so the hr-scoped claim must not be a candidate — not filtered out after retrieval, never retrieved. The reachable claim shares no vocabulary with the query, so any hit at all is a hit on the hr claim.
